title: Eleusinian mysteries as near-death rituals

tellings.quote: because if you look at the linian Mysteries or any of these other rituals they involve the temporary killing of the physical body through a near-death experience

plain: The Eleusinian Mysteries, secret religious rites of ancient Greece held at Eleusis, may have worked by bringing people close to death. Michels puts this forward himself, without naming a source: he says these and similar rituals "involve the temporary killing of the physical body through a near-death experience," which would make them a deliberate way to reach experiences beyond the body.
